title: SemanticCard v0.1 (REV1)
$comment: DRAFT — NOT IMPLEMENTATION-STABLE. Revised under human adjudication during M1A REV1. Has NOT passed human review. See specs/semantic-card-v0.1.md and docs/reviews/M1A_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION_REV1.md.
description: Machine-readable semantic INDEX entry for one knowledge concept. An index, not a summary: it must not duplicate human note prose, and it must never become an independent source of truth. Card-level state is a MAINTENANCE state; only claims and relations carry an epistemic state, and a machine inference may never be recorded as verified. ENFORCEMENT BOUNDARY: JSON Schema validates the STRUCTURE OF THIS ONE ARTIFACT only. It cannot check that an evidenceRef.sourceUnitId exists in a SourceMap, that a relation target resolves to a real card, or that a note anchor exists. Cross-artifact reference integrity belongs to a future Cross-artifact Validator (see docs/reviews/M1A_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION_REV1.md CH-11).

schemaVersion.description: Instance-format version, distinct from the contract name in contractVersion.

knowledgeId.description: Stable OPAQUE identity (SC-3). Must not encode or derive from a note title, file path, heading text or location. Concrete format (UUID/ULID/other) is deliberately not frozen at v0.1.

anchor.description: A note anchor. block-id is preferred; heading-path is the fallback. Line numbers are never a long-term anchor (SC-11).

value.description: The anchor itself: a block id or a heading path. Not a hash.

fingerprint.description: Content fingerprint. SHA-256 is the default algorithm (SC-19).

value.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase-or-uppercase hex characters (RM-35). The HASHED OBJECT semantics (raw bytes vs canonical JSON) remain DEFERRED.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to evidence. Must identify something: at least one of sourceUnitId or locator, and every present value must be non-empty (SC-20).

note.description: Short explanation for a human reader. Never authoritative content.

epistemicState.description: Epistemic state of a claim or relation. Never a card-level property (SC-5).

epistemicBasis.description: Who assigned the epistemic state, so machine inference is distinguishable from human judgement (SC-14). `human-verified` is the NARROW verification primitive (SC-28): it is the only basis that can justify `epistemicState: verified`, and it still requires at least one evidence reference or provenance entry. A machine may never emit it.

label.description: Human-readable label. Has NO identity function and may change freely (SC-3).

maintenanceState.description: MAINTENANCE state of this index, not a truth value (SC-5, SC-8).

semanticCore.description: Bounded machine-readable core. Exists for matching and routing, not for reading (SC-9).

summary.description: Navigation and matching description. Purpose-stated and length-capped so it cannot become a note summary (SC-9).

scopeNote.description: What this card deliberately does NOT cover, to prevent false matches.

humanNoteRef.description: Where the source of truth lives. Never a production Vault path in experiments (SC-10).

sectionIndex.description: Anchor-level index of the note. May be empty, which honestly states that no sections are identifiable (SC-12).

gist.description: One-line pointer. Not a content copy.

claims.description: Claim-level index. Carries NO free-text field: a claim's content lives in the note, and the card points at it (SC-4, SC-13).

allOf.$comment: SC-13 / SC-28: `verified` is unavailable to a machine. It requires an EXPLICIT verification basis — `human-verified` is the only value that can justify it — plus at least one evidence reference. Ordinary evidence (`evidenceRefs` alone, with no basis) is NOT verification, and `basis: machine-inferred` with `verified` is therefore also illegal, since the basis must literally equal `human-verified`.

relations.description: Typed edges. Each is an inference and carries its own epistemic state and basis (SC-6).

target.description: At least one target reference, and every present reference must be non-empty (SC-15, SC-20).

allOf.$comment: SC-17: a relation without provenance must be flagged for review.

SC-13 / SC-28 applies to edges too: verification requires an explicit `human-verified` basis plus at least one provenance entry. A machine inference can never be `verified`, and provenance alone is not verification.

learningAssets.description: Index of learning material by pedagogical function, so assets survive summarisation (SC-18).

ref.description: Must identify somewhere: at least one non-empty reference (SC-20).

summary.description: Retrieval label only. Not the asset's content (SC-9).

unresolved.description: CURRENT OPEN unresolved items only. Closed history belongs to change/run history, not to the card (SC-24).

unresolvedId.description: Stable OPAQUE item identity (SC-27), so a downstream artifact can reference or close this item without quoting its editable description.

integrity.description: Synchronisation bookkeeping. A state may not be asserted without the data that justifies it (SC-19, SC-21).

checkedAt.description: Required whenever any state is asserted.

checkedAgainst.description: Proof that the state was computed. Required when state is `ok`.

unavailableReason.description: Why a state could not be established. Required when state is `unknown`.
